name: Forced displacement
summary: OCHA counts over 323,000 displaced in South Kivu 6–9 Nov, the largest new event this month but below the 500,000 line
state: OCHA reported on 11 Nov that fighting between the Congolese army and FRN rebels displaced over 323,000 people in Kalehe and Kabare, South Kivu, between 6 and 9 Nov, most towards Itebero in North Kivu (Actualite.cd; Radio Okapi, 13 Nov). That is below the 500,000-in-a-month Watch line, but fighting continued to 13 Nov and the figure may rise. UNHCR said on 10 Nov that about 64,000 people have fled northern Nigeria to Niger in 2026 (UN News). Normal is kept with a rising trend.
for_you: Displaced families in South Kivu need shelter, food and water, and aid agencies report access problems. Large movements can spread disease and push people towards neighbouring countries.
rubric_hit: Normal: largest new event ~323,000 displaced (South Kivu, 6–9 Nov), below the >500,000-in-a-month Watch line
